# SOLAR HE and Sons (Solar Power Install)

> Solar panel installation company in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines. TESDA-trained installers, backed by HE & SONS, a 50-year-old Chevron Lubricants distributor. Fast, efficient, reliable installation for homes, businesses, farms, and LGUs.

## Key facts
- Service: solar panel installation, free site survey, wiring and testing, net metering assistance, maintenance and repair, system upgrades
- Team: installers trained by TESDA (Technical Education and Skills Development Authority) in solar installation
- Backing: HE & SONS, 50 years in business as a Chevron Lubricants distributor
- Speed: most home systems installed in 1 to 3 days after the site survey
- Payments accepted: Pag-IBIG, SSS, Home Credit, GCash
- Service area: Cagayan de Oro and nearby areas, Northern Mindanao
- Phone: +63 917 123 4641
- Email: install@solarheandsons.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Panels supplied by sister company Fil Solar Depot: https://alfiesuperhalk.github.io/FilSolarDepot/

## How it works
1. Book online or call +63 917 123 4641
2. Free site survey and clear quote
3. Installation, usually 1 to 3 days
4. Power on, with ongoing support and maintenance
